observation: Candidate common inspection model for Prometeo objects: Surface + Book + Flow + Trace. Reuse existing workflow/state/lineage/timing mechanisms instead of creating a new authority.

views.BOOK: Engineering Memory: components, capabilities, origin, decisions, failures, dependencies, evolution, examples and validators.
views.FLOW: Compiled decision/state graph: guards, inputs, allowed next states, authority boundaries, fallbacks, retries and terminal outcomes.
views.TRACE: Observed path and timing: decisions, tools, waits, retries and checkpoints.

flow_invariants: TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/ERROR branches must all resolve to explicit destinations.
Loops require a retry budget and exit condition.
UNKNOWN stays distinct from FALSE and from zero.
Every human-decision node states the minimum human action and what machine work can continue in parallel.
FLOW is generated from existing contracts/state machines/packets where possible; it is not a second source of truth.
speed_rule: Compile decisions once into local/packet context, evaluate them locally, record local timestamps/events, and persist only coalesced semantic checkpoints or returns. Do not add a remote database or GitHub round-trip per decision.

local_trace_candidate.durable_policy: Micro-events stay local/ephemeral during active work; checkpoint/RETURN stores compact summaries and important boundary timestamps. Missing time remains UNKNOWN.

visual_candidate: Each object may expose Surface | Book | Flow | Trace. Flow uses boxes/arrows with current node and traversed path highlighted; Trace overlays actual timings on the same graph.
better_questions: ¿Existe alguna combinación de resultado que no tenga una salida explícita?
¿Qué nodo consume más tiempo real y puede resolverse localmente o adelantarse?
¿Qué intervención humana existe por una limitación operativa y no por una decisión genuina?
¿El diagrama sigue siendo una proyección fiel de las reglas ejecutables?
non_goal: Do not create a new scheduler, CURRENT, or per-object parallel authority.
